name: OKX
tagline: Exchange REST and WebSocket API for spot, derivatives, and account trading.
description: OKX provides a production trading API for market data and private account operations across spot and derivatives. Developers use REST for request/response workflows and WebSocket streams for real-time prices, order books, and account updates, with API-key based signing for authenticated trading.

auth.details: API key, secret, and passphrase; signed requests via OK-ACCESS-* headers (self-serve from account).

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access included with account; trading fees apply; rate limits by VIP tier
pricing.paid_plans: VIP tiers raise rate limits and may lower trading fees; no separate API subscription fee published

rate_limits: Per-endpoint limits by VIP level; see OKX docs rate-limit tables
use_cases: fetch ticker and order book market data
place and cancel spot or derivatives orders
